 Optical Extensometer 
 Optical extensometer
The optical extensometer DeltaL is a non-contact deformation measuring device for material testing based on high-resolution video technology using measuring marks applied to the specimen.
 Optical extensometer DeltaL 70 for determining longitudinal strain measurement
 Optimal alignment of labelled samples using a laser
 The DeltaLW 80 optical extensometer can be used to determine longitudinal and transverse strain
The optical extensometer is used for optical non-contact strain measurement in tensile, compression and bending tests
Advantages and Features 
Non-contact optical measuring device, also suitable for thin and sensitive specimens 
Easy to set up 
Laser alignment support 
Suitable for both strain measurement and strain control 
Strain value is transmitted via stable analog signal 
0.5 μm resolution, class 0.5 according to ISO 9513 and ASTM E83 B-1 possible 
Enables the determination of elastic parameters: 
elastic straight line 
equivalent yield point 
yield strength 
elongation at break in the specified field of view 
Can be used for strain measurement in temperature chambers/ furnaces 
Various models available for longitudinal or longitudinal and transverse strain measurement (DeltaLW 80) 
Simple operation directly via LabMaster testing software 
Stereoscopic camera arrangement with 2 cameras 
reduces potential interferences 
enables precise measurement of length changes, even with an inclination angle of the test plane of up to 6° 
Various options for convenient specimen marking using a stamp or template
